note: The Maldives: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days, 3 months (Pakistan) or 30 days; everyone else gets a free 30-day visa on arrival, with a confirmed booking, a return ticket and the IMUGA declaration (not modelled); Israelis are refused since 15 April 2025 (taken as a visa). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against Maldives Immigration's own tourist visa page (updated 10 September 2026): a tourist visa is granted on arrival to every foreigner, and Israeli passports are refused from 15 April 2025; the page gives no length and names no exempt nationality, which stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of the Maldives
sources.said: Most visitors to the Maldives must obtain a free 30-day visa on arrival unless they are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries. However, entry is refused to citizens of Israel . ... Citizens of the following countries may enter the Maldives without a visa for the following period: 90 days Azerbaijan India Malaysia Russia Sri Lanka 3 months Pakistan 30 days Cambodia China Guyana Kazakhstan Kyrgyzstan Mongolia Morocco Seychelles

sources.title: Maldives Immigration: Tourist Visa - On Arrival
sources.said: Tourist visa is granted on arrival to the Maldives. Foreigners traveling to Maldives as tourists do not require pre-approval for the visa. However, visitors must satisfy the basic entry requirements to get immigration clearance upon arrival. Note: Effective from 15th April 2025, entry to the Maldives will not be granted on Israeli passports. ... updated: 10/09/2026
